summary: Terminal plugins prepare a network device's SSH shell for Ansible, for example by disabling paging, detecting errors and entering privileged mode. They map one-to-one to platforms and are loaded from ansible_network_os.
questions: What turns off paging on network devices when Ansible connects?
How does Ansible enter enable mode on a switch?

answer_card.title: What terminal plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Terminal plugins initialize a network device's SSH shell for Ansible: disabling automatic paging, detecting errors in output and entering privileged mode where needed. One plugin per platform, selected from `ansible_network_os`.
